message.content: {"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study uses 16S rRNA gene PCR and DNA–DNA hybridization on a microarray to profile bacterial species in gingival crevicular fluid; Organism listed as Homo sapiens refers to host source but the measured targets are bacterial species.","justification":"The assay profiles microbial species (bacterial 16S) rather than human gene expression on a transcriptome microarray, so it is not a human microarray expression profiling study."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Sample annotations list Disease: periodontitis; study description focuses on periodontal disease and subgingival microbiota.","justification":"The dataset concerns periodontitis, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD)."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples are gingival crevicular fluid (GCF) and subgingival plaque (PP) taken from periodontal sites; organism part is oral, not CNS.","justification":"No human brain or CNS tissues were sampled; material is oral microbiome/gingival fluid."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Samples are clinical GCF and PP specimens from 17 subjects with periodontal disease as described in the study.","justification":"The dataset uses direct patient clinical samples, not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Experimental factors show SAMPLE_TYPE and all subjects are listed with periodontitis; study compares GCF vs PP within periodontitis patients rather than cases vs healthy controls.","justification":"There is no case (ALS/FTD) versus healthy control design for the target neurodegenerative disease; design is intra-subject comparison of oral sample types."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples are oral (gingival crevicular fluid and subgingival plaque), not brain regions.","justification":"The sampled tissues are non-CNS and therefore irrelevant to ALS-FTD-affected brain regions."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology listed as Array assay (DNA–DNA hybridization microarray for bacterial species); not RNA-seq or proteomics.","justification":"No incompatible technologies such as RNA-seq or proteomics are used, although the array is for microbial species profiling rather than human expression microarrays."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: does not meet inclusion criteria 1–3. It is not a human gene expression microarray study (targets bacterial 16S/species), does not concern ALS-FTD (disease = periodontitis), and does not involve CNS tissue (oral samples). Although the assay is an array, the biological questions and sample types are irrelevant to the ALS-FTD human CNS expression profiling scope."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Description: human microRNA Microarray Kit Agilent; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The study uses human samples and miRNA expression profiling by microarray (Agilent), matching human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and Description: MiRNA expression profiling in human medullary thyroid carcinoma; samples are tumor and adjacent normal thyroid tissue.","justification":"The disease under study is medullary thyroid carcinoma, not ALS or FTD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: thyroid; Description: matched tumor and adjacent normal frozen tissues were obtained from thyroid of patients.","justification":"Samples are from thyroid tissue, not brain/CNS."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: matched tumor and adjacent normal frozen tissues from patients; no cell lines or in vitro disease models reported.","justification":"Tissues are patient surgical specimens (tumor and adjacent normal), not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: matched tumor and adjacent normal tissue were obtained and hybridized on microarray; validation set also includes tumors and normals.","justification":"Study compares cases (tumor tissue) with matched controls (adjacent normal tissue), i.e., a case/control paired design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: thyroid; Title: medullary thyroid carcinoma (thyroid tissue).","justification":"Samples are non-CNS (thyroid), therefore not from brain regions relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The assay is microarray-based RNA profiling, which is compatible with the inclusion requirement for microarray expression profiling."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Exclude: although this is human microarray expression data with a case/control design, the study targets medullary thyroid carcinoma and uses thyroid (non-CNS) tissue. It does not pertain to ALS-FTD or relevant CNS regions, so it fails the disease and tissue inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The experiment is RNA expression profiling performed on human samples using microarray (array) technology."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and sample metadata indicate SPOAN (spastic paraplegia, optic atrophy, and neuropathy) syndrome; Disease field lists SPOAN.","justification":"The disease studied is SPOAN syndrome, not amyotrophic lateral sclerosis or frontotemporal dementia (ALS-FTD)." },"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part: Skin fibroblast; Sample type: fibroblast samples (skin).","justification":"Samples are skin-derived fibroblasts, not human brain or CNS tissue." },"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples: fibroblast samples from 4 SPOAN affected patients and 4 healthy controls; Experimental Factors: cell type; Organism part: Skin fibroblast.","justification":"The dataset uses patient-derived primary fibroblast cell cultures (in vitro cells), which are patient-derived non-CNS cell lines." },"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title: Gene expression comparison between fibroblasts samples of control and SPOAN affected patients; Sample count: 4 SPOAN affected patients and 4 healthy controls.","justification":"The study compares affected patients versus healthy controls (case vs control design across individuals)." },"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: Skin fibroblast; no brain/CNS regions sampled.","justification":"No brain regions are sampled; skin fibroblasts are not CNS regions relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration." },"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The technology is microarray-based expression profiling (compatible); no RNA-seq or proteomics indicated." },"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is human microarray expression profiling, the study investigates SPOAN syndrome using patient-derived skin fibroblasts rather than ALS-FTD and does not sample CNS regions relevant to ALS-FTD. In addition, it uses patient-derived in vitro fibroblast cultures (excluded by criterion 4). Therefore it does not meet the disease and tissue requirements and should be excluded." },"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Dataset used human samples and microarray-based transcription profiling (array/RNA assay)."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title and Description refer to Hereditary Motor and Sensory Neuropathies (HMSN1A, HMSN-LOM) and CCFDN syndrome; no mention of ALS or FTD.","justification":"The study focuses on inherited peripheral demyelinating neuropathies, not ALS-FTD spectrum disorders."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title/Description: 'Transcription profiling of human Schwann cells'; samples are Schwann cell lines (peripheral glia). Organism part not listed as CNS.","justification":"Schwann cells are peripheral nervous system glia (PNS), not CNS/brain tissue relevant to ALS-FTD."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'We analyzed human Schwann cell lines from three normal subjects, one HMSN-LOM patient, two HMSN-1A patients and two CCFDN patients' and 'Schwann cell lines'.","justification":"Samples are patient-derived/in vitro Schwann cell lines (cell culture), which meets the exclusion criterion for in vitro disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: includes patient-derived neuropathy samples and three healthy subjects; comparisons made between neuropathy samples and healthy subjects (and a common reference).","justification":"The design compares patient samples to healthy controls (case vs control), albeit using a common reference channel."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Sample type: Schwann cells (peripheral nervous system); no CNS/brain regions reported.","justification":"Samples derive from PNS Schwann cells rather than brain regions affected in ALS-FTD; therefore sampled tissue is not relevant to ALS-FTD neurodegeneration."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: Array assay; Study type: transcription profiling by array.","justification":"The study used microarray technology (compatible); there is no indication of RNA-seq or proteomics."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset uses human microarray expression profiling and has a case/control comparison, it does not pertain to ALS-FTD and does not contain CNS brain tissue. Additionally, samples are patient-derived in vitro Schwann cell lines (PNS), which are excluded. Therefore the dataset fails multiple inclusion criteria."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: 'transcription profiling by array'; Technology: 'Array assay'; Assay: Affymetrix Clariom™ D Assay, human; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Expression profiling was performed on human RNA using an Affymetrix microarray platform (Clariom D), indicating human microarray expression profiling."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title and description refer to frontotemporal lobar degeneration (FTLD), including sporadic FTLD-TDP and C9ORF72-familial FTLD.","justification":"FTLD/FTD is the frontotemporal dementia spectrum; the dataset includes C9ORF72-associated familial FTLD, a genetic cause that overlaps with the ALS-FTD spectrum, so the study is relevant to ALS-FTD."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'RNA extracted from human frontal cortex area 8'; Samples: Organism Homo sapiens; Organism part: Brodman (1909) area 8.","justification":"Samples are postmortem human frontal cortex (Brodmann area 8), a CNS region."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description and sample attributes indicate postmortem brain tissue from controls and FTLD patients; no cell lines or in vitro models are listed.","justification":"All samples are human postmortem brain tissue (clinical patient samples), not patient-derived in vitro cell lines or experimental disease models."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental design: 'disease state design'; Groups: controls (n=10), sporadic FTLD-TDP (n=10), C9ORF72-familial FTLD (n=10).","justification":"The study compares disease groups to controls, i.e., a case/control design."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Description: 'frontal cortex area 8, the main area afected in FTLD'.","justification":"Frontal cortex (Brodmann area 8) is a region significantly affected in FTLD/FTD and therefore relevant to ALS-FTD investigations."},"q7_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Technology: 'Array assay'; Assay: Affymetrix Clariom™ D (microarray); Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The study used microarray expression profiling (Affymetrix), which is compatible with inclusion; no RNA-seq or proteomics technologies are reported."},"q8_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"This dataset meets inclusion criteria: human microarray expression profiling of postmortem CNS tissue (frontal cortex BA8), focuses on FTLD/FTD including C9ORF72 familial cases relevant to the ALS-FTD spectrum, uses a case/control design, and employs compatible microarray technology. It does not use cell lines or incompatible technologies."},"q9_include_dataset":{"answer":"Yes"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"The study uses microarray-based transcription profiling on human samples (RNA assays on array platform), so it meets the human microarray expression profiling requirement."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Title: Complete TLR3 deficiency; Disease states: TLR3-/- Patient, MyD88-/- Patient, UNC93B-/- Patient, Healthy, TLR3+/- Patient. No mention of Alzheimer's disease or AD pathology.","justification":"The dataset investigates TLR3/MyD88/UNC93B deficiencies (innate immunity defects). It does not pertain to Alzheimer's disease; the 'AD' in the sample list refers to autosomal dominant TLR3 deficiency, not Alzheimer’s disease."},"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type: skin fibroblast, PBMC; Description: 'Fibroblast cells and PBMCs from donors...'; Organism part: Not found.","justification":"Samples are peripheral blood mononuclear cells and cultured skin fibroblasts, not human brain/CNS tissue."},"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description: 'The fibroblast cells were cultured in DMEM medium... The PBMCs were cultured in RPMI medium... Different kinetics of poly(I:C) stimulations were performed...'","justification":"Samples are patient-derived primary cells cultured and stimulated in vitro (fibroblast cultures and stimulated PBMCs), which constitutes patient-derived in vitro cell models and therefore meets the exclusion criterion."},"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Description/sample summary: 'A total of 3 healthy controls, 1 AD TLR3-deficient patient, 1 AR TLR3-deficient patient, 1 AR UNC-93B-deficient patient, 1 MyD88 deficient patient were used in this study.' Experimental Factor: DISEASE STATE (Healthy, patient).","justification":"The study includes healthy control donors and patients with immune deficiencies, so a case vs control comparison is present."},"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Cell type: skin fibroblast, PBMC; no brain regions listed.","justification":"No brain/CNS regions are sampled (so the specific exclusion for irrelevant brain regions like cerebellum does not apply here). However the dataset still fails inclusion for other reasons."},"q7_intermediate_phenotype":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Disease state entries relate to TLR3/MyD88/UNC93B deficiency; no AD staging or Braak information provided.","justification":"The dataset does not involve Alzheimer's disease phenotypes or Braak staging (intermediate or otherwise)."},"q8_familial_alzheimer_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Disease states: TLR3-/- Patient, TLR3+/- Patient, MyD88-/-, UNC93B-/-; no mention of familial Alzheimer's disease.","justification":"This study is unrelated to Alzheimer's disease familial cases; 'AD' in the record denotes autosomal dominant TLR3 deficiency, not familial AD."},"q9_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"The technology is microarray (array-based transcription profiling), which is compatible with the inclusion requirement."},"q10_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although the dataset is human and uses microarray expression profiling, it does not investigate Alzheimer's disease and does not use human CNS tissue; instead it profiles patient-derived cultured fibroblasts and PBMCs from individuals with innate immunity deficiencies. It therefore fails key inclusion criteria (target disease = AD and CNS tissue) and also meets exclusion criterion for patient-derived in vitro cell models."},"q11_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}

{"q1_human_microarray_expression_profiling":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Study type: transcription profiling by array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay; Organism: Homo sapiens.","justification":"Human RNA expression profiling performed using microarray/array technology."},"q2_target_disease":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Samples Disease: Parkinson's disease listed among DISEASESTATE and Disease fields.","justification":"Parkinson's disease is included; PD is a Lewy body disease (falls under LBD inclusion)." },"q3_human_cns_tissue":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Organism part / Source Characteristics: olfactory mucosa; Cell types: neurosphere, fibroblast; samples derived from olfactory mucosa.","justification":"Samples are from olfactory mucosa and neurosphere-derived cell lines (peripheral/olfactory tissue), not direct human CNS/brain tissue." },"q4_non_clinical":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Title/Description: 'neurosphere-derived cell lines from patients'; 'patient-derived cells provide informative models'; Experimental Factors: CELLTYPE includes neurosphere, fibroblast.","justification":"Study uses patient-derived in vitro neurosphere cell lines (cell culture disease models), which meets exclusion criterion for non-clinical in vitro models." },"q5_case_control_design":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Experimental Designs: disease_state_design; Experimental Factors DISEASESTATE values: normal, Parkinson's disease, schizophrenia.","justification":"Design includes disease vs normal comparisons (case/control groups)." },"q6_irrelevant_brain_region":{"answer":"Yes","evidence":"Organism part: olfactory mucosa (peripheral/olfactory tissue), not specified as CNS brain region.","justification":"Tissue source is olfactory mucosa (peripheral), not CNS brain regions commonly sampled for LBD neuropathology; therefore tissue is outside the required CNS regions." },"q7_familial_disease":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Clinical/familial: Not found; Description references patient cohorts without mentioning familial LBD.","justification":"No indication the cases are familial-only; appears to be sporadic patient-derived samples." },"q8_incompatible_technology":{"answer":"No","evidence":"Study type indicates array; Technology: Array assay; Assay by Molecule: RNA assay.","justification":"Microarray/array-based transcription profiling used (compatible technology)." },"q9_inclusion_justification":{"justification":"Although this is a human microarray study including Parkinson's disease cases and a case/control design, it uses patient-derived neurosphere cell lines from olfactory mucosa (in vitro models, peripheral tissue). This violates exclusion criteria: (4) patient-derived in vitro cell lines and (3)/(6) lack of CNS brain tissue relevant to LBD. Therefore the dataset should be excluded." },"q10_include_dataset":{"answer":"No"}}
